contrastMeter.shown.description: Captions tab, contrast meter: the meter: the captions' contrast ratio ("4.4"), where it was measured (time, when where is yes) and how readable it is (words, text.contrastMeter.easy and the others).

contrastMeter.spoken.description: Captions tab, contrast meter: the meter as a screen reader says it; words is how readable, as inside a sentence (English lower-cases it).

imagesPanel.formats.description: Images tab: the images Flown takes, inside the hint under Add image. PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG and GIF are file formats (keep them).

graphicsPanel.full.description: Graphics: said when Add is used and the video already has the most pop-ups a project keeps; {n} is that number.

titleTrack.chapterThere.description: Editor notice: Add chapter at a place where a chapter already starts; {title} is that chapter's name.

titleTrack.chapterAtEnd.description: Editor notice: Add chapter at the very end of the video.
